task_description: Translate every English Markdown (.md) file in /projects/sandbox/oh-my-kiro to Brazilian Portuguese in-place, preserving YAML front-matter, fenced code blocks, inline code, URLs, file paths, CLI commands, identifier names, technical product/tool names (AWS, Kiro, MCP, CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform, Docker), consecrated tech terms left in English (deploy, commit, push, pull request, endpoint, payload, token, middleware, runtime, framework, pipeline, webhook), technical acronyms (API, SDK, IAM, JSON, YAML, etc.), and a small set of test-anchored English literals. Files already in Portuguese or entirely in Chinese are skipped. Test fixtures under tests/knowledge/fixtures/ are NEVER modified because the test scripts (tests/knowledge/l1-*.sh) grep for exact substrings inside them. Use 'você' (informal technical), no em dashes (—). Deliverable: a single feature branch (`feat/translate-md-ptbr`) with reviewable per-area commits.

verification.test_quality: n/a (pure translation; no test code added or modified — git diff main HEAD -- tests/ is empty)
verification.summary: 183 .md files audited: 173 translated, 7 skipped (no English prose), 3 fixture-protected. Baseline test counts preserved exactly: pytest 60 passed / 8 failed (with documented ignore set), bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 27 passed / 1 failed (pre-existing 'OMK SECTIONS' fail on coding.md, unchanged from main), bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 1 pass / 3 total scripts (pre-existing l1-rules-injection + l1-corruption-recall failures, unchanged from main). All 9 test-anchored English literals (Coding agent, GTM, Evidence before claims, Skill Routing, Authority Matrix, episodes.md, BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES, **Verdict: APPROVE**, **Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**) preserved. Every skills/*/SKILL.md YAML front-matter byte-identical to main. Zero fenced-code-block edits across all touched files. Zero em dashes added in any translation deliverable. tests/knowledge/fixtures/ untouched. See .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/audit.md for full audit.
